说明: 修 bug、加功能和守规矩加代码质量（11-08 起）；S1 = 判对错 70% + 代码质量 30%。代码质量由独立评审（Claude，新开的子会话）只看随机甲乙标签的改动打分，打完才揭晓；评审没看过工具的对话和用时。

理由.结构与分层: 只在 CloudMerge 两个比较函数里改按整秒比，加私有 wholeSecond，测试放对文件，改动面小。
理由.可读性: wholeSecond 命名直白，注释讲清为何向下取整及残余风险，测试用 macs 数组模拟两台 Mac，好读。
理由.一致性: 沿用原有元组比较与中文注释风格，测试复用 insertRemotePinned 等已有辅助方法。
理由.稳健写法: 按参考日期向下取整，lastUsedAt 一并按整秒比；未覆盖整秒边界和负时间戳等情形。
理由.可维护性: 两个测试分别覆盖 Pinned 与 Pinboard 两条去重路径，直接复现两台 Mac 各选各的，无夹带改动。

理由_en.结构与分层: Only the two comparison functions in CloudMerge change to whole-second comparison, via a private wholeSecond helper; tests go in the right file and the change is small.
理由_en.可读性: wholeSecond is plainly named and its comment explains why it rounds down and what risk remains; the tests model two Macs with a macs array and read well.
理由_en.一致性: Keeps the existing tuple comparison and comment style; the tests reuse existing helpers such as insertRemotePinned.
理由_en.稳健写法: Rounds down from the reference date and compares lastUsedAt at whole seconds too; does not cover the second boundary or negative timestamps.
理由_en.可维护性: Two tests cover the Pinned and Pinboard deduplication paths and reproduce the two Macs choosing differently; no unrelated changes.

理由.结构与分层: 修复同样集中在 CloudMerge 比较函数与私有 wholeSecond，测试放对文件，无越界改动。
理由.可读性: wholeSecond 无注释，测试里 localID == a ? b : a 等三元较绕，单个测试反复改模型字段。
理由.一致性: 沿用元组比较并把原注释的『待真机核实』改成实际做法；新测试直接构造模型测内部函数，与原集成测试风格不同。
理由.稳健写法: 参数化测试覆盖 0.9999/1.0 与负时间戳的整秒边界、全字段相同不删的规则，并核对库里实际副本数。
理由.可维护性: 测试覆盖面广，但两个参数化函数同时测 Pinboard 与 Pinned、手工改字段多，字段顺序一改就要跟着改。

理由_en.结构与分层: The fix is likewise limited to the CloudMerge comparison functions and a private wholeSecond helper; tests are in the right file, nothing out of scope.
理由_en.可读性: wholeSecond has no comment; the tests use convoluted ternaries such as localID == a ? b : a, and one test keeps mutating model fields.
理由_en.一致性: Keeps the tuple comparison and replaces the old "verify on device" comment with what it actually does; the new tests build models and test internals directly, unlike the existing integration-style tests.
理由_en.稳健写法: Parameterized tests cover the 0.9999/1.0 second boundary, negative timestamps and the rule that fully identical items are kept, and check the actual copy count in the store.
理由_en.可维护性: Broad coverage, but two parameterized functions test Pinboard and Pinned at once with many hand-edited fields, so a change in field order breaks them.
